script_text: Cancer, the cosmic tides are shifting dramatically this week, pulling you toward a major crossroads. Early on, Mars in your 3rd House squares your ruling Moon, creating friction in daily communication; Monday will be your toughest day as misunderstandings run high. However, by Wednesday, Venus in your 4th House trines the Moon, bringing warmth to your home. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday as Mercury enters your 5th House, sparking a creative and romantic renaissance. Late week, Jupiter in your 11th House sextile Neptune in your 9th House opens dreamy social doors, making the weekend perfect for collaborations. Wednesday is your power day because Venus in your 4th House trines your ruling Moon, while Monday is your worst day because Mars in your 3rd House squares the Moon. Embrace your watery intuition to navigate career opportunities and express love authentically. Follow for daily updates.
